verdict: M254 is numerically reproducible and establishes a useful paired trace-level hardware direction: under identical running-BN capture, ordered ten-sample cohort, four Conv operators, train-only catalog and cycle resources, PAFT reduces bit-sparse work by 13.85907284561026% and candidate work by 13.155263677442946%. The independently replayed WIDE144 and SHARED96 candidate-cycle gains are 1.1514612792502774x and 1.152956085401344x, and PAFT is faster on all 10 paired samples and lower-work on all four operators. All 80 packed support payloads plus 80 float companions independently rehash, decompress and agree bit-for-bit across positive, negative and temporal-change planes; 103,680,000 total partition vectors are replayed without importing M251/M254. Clean producer replay is byte-identical and a wrong SHA is rejected before output creation. However, the intended pattern mechanism does not improve: PAFT pattern efficiency is 0.8104223675148693% worse, so the gain is activity-driven. The full profiled zurich_city_09_a sequence has 1.0189020311889285% worse running-BN AEE under PAFT, even though global single-seed valid825 AEE improves 0.5730215096601543%. Therefore M254 supports a scoped activity-driven Conv trace result, not an accuracy-performance Pareto, integrated hardware measurement, system result or headline.

findings.title: The profiled full sequence does not establish an accuracy-performance Pareto
findings.evidence: Across all 64 running-BN valid frames of zurich_city_09_a, PAFT AEE is 1.36565899929375 versus control 1.351884619446875, a 1.0189020311889285% regression. The exact ten hardware frames average a small 0.237301327675421% gain but split only 5 wins and 5 losses.
findings.required_fix: Capture hardware traces across the full valid825 cohort or at least multiple sequences and report paired cycle/accuracy strata; do not join the global accuracy number to a one-sequence hardware trace as a Pareto point.

findings.title: The measured gain is activity-driven, not improved pattern efficiency
findings.evidence: PAFT natural pattern speedup is 1.5406415197256267x versus control 1.5532292368800835x, a -0.8104223675148693% efficiency change. Holding control pattern efficiency predicts 43,679,489.4077 candidate ops, below PAFT's actual 44,036,370; the beyond-activity term is -0.8170438738207225%.
findings.required_fix: Describe M254 as activity reduction. For a pattern-aware co-design claim, retrain or regularize until the fixed-catalog pattern-efficiency term is nonnegative and independently reproduced.

findings.title: Accuracy evidence is single-seed and lacks a common runtime evaluator SHA
findings.evidence: The global valid825 AEE direction is +0.5730215096601543% with 430 frame wins and 395 losses. M247 explicitly records no multi-seed confidence interval and no same evaluator runtime SHA bound for both arms.
findings.required_fix: Repeat paired seeds with the same evaluator binary/runtime SHA and report confidence intervals before an accuracy or co-design headline.

findings.title: The cycle result remains an abstract perfect-overlap model
findings.evidence: All 17,280 phases in both arms and both ports are compute-bound under max(compute, matcher, packer, next-DMA). No integrated RTL/VCS trace proves dependency timing, finite queues, backpressure or variable-latency SRAM behavior.
findings.required_fix: Build or trace-drive a matched matcher/packer/PWP service island and prove cycle equality on both PAFT and control subsets.

findings.title: No checkpoint-specific INT8/PWP numerical bridge exists
findings.evidence: M251r2 proves universal signed12 capacity only. PAFT/control INT8 weight exports, exact PWP payload identities, Acc19 proof or overflow guard, and Conv/BN/ATLIF output equivalence are absent.
findings.required_fix: Export both checkpoints, materialize PWP payloads and prove integer numerical equivalence or bounded error before integrating the cycle result.

findings.title: The current M77 handoff still cannot independently reconstruct zero leakage
findings.evidence: The incoming M77 directory contains only the catalog and co-produced admission contract; raw M73 calibration trace and train/valid key lists are absent. M254 transitively trusts the M251 admission.
findings.required_fix: Transfer or directly hash-bind the raw M73 trace and split lists in the final artifact, then rerun zero-overlap checks.

findings.title: Hardware coverage is ten frames from one sequence
findings.evidence: The 10/10 result is exact for spaced frames from zurich_city_09_a, not cross-sequence or event-density coverage.
findings.required_fix: Extend identical paired trace capture across sequences and event-density strata.

findings.title: Targeted Conv activity reduction must not be equated with whole-network spike reduction
findings.evidence: M254 finds 13.85907284561026% less bit-sparse four-Conv source work on its trace, while M247 reports only 0.11533721185305046% total-spike reduction over valid825. The populations and cohorts differ.
findings.required_fix: Keep operator-local work and global spike metrics separate and add matched full-network profiling before generalization.

findings.title: WIDE144 is not width/area/frequency normalized
findings.evidence: The separate 144-byte PWP service port is wider than the 96-byte weight service, and its routing/storage cost is unmodeled. SHARED96 gives nearly the same PAFT/control ratio and is the fair conservative port point.
findings.required_fix: Lead with SHARED96 for conservative algorithm gain and synthesize matched ports before throughput-per-area claims.

findings.title: Pattern-table residence and cold-start traffic remain implicit
findings.evidence: The frozen catalog table is required for both arms, but its residence/capacity and cold-load traffic are not part of the phase schedule. Common omission preserves the paired direction but not absolute module cycles.
findings.required_fix: Declare resident capacity or add cold/warm cycle and energy rows.

allowed_claims: On the frozen paired running-BN ten-sample four-Conv trace, PAFT reduces exact bit-sparse work by 13.85907284561026% and candidate work by 13.155263677442946%.

Under the same declared isolated model, PAFT/control candidate-cycle throughput ratios are 1.1514612792502774x for WIDE144 and 1.152956085401344x for SHARED96, with PAFT faster on all ten paired samples.
The measured hardware direction is activity-driven; fixed-catalog pattern efficiency is 0.8104223675148693% worse under PAFT.
The global paired single-seed valid825 running-BN AEE direction improves 0.5730215096601543%, while the full profiled sequence regresses 1.0189020311889285%.
All paired payloads and calculations independently replay, clean producer replay is byte-identical, and wrong SHA injection fails closed.
forbidden_claims: PAFT improves pattern efficiency under M77
The 1.151x-1.153x ratio is system speedup or full-network speedup
M254 establishes an accuracy-performance Pareto on the profiled sequence
The WIDE144 or SHARED96 result is RTL-integrated measured throughput or matched throughput per area
The accuracy result is multi-seed significant or fully runtime-identical
The checkpoints have proven INT8/Acc19/PWP numerical execution
M254 proves power, energy, paper PPA or a headline result

next_gate.first: Capture paired PAFT/control running-BN hardware traces across multiple valid sequences and align every cycle row with per-sequence accuracy.
next_gate.second: Improve or reframe PAFT: current benefit is activity sparsification, not catalog pattern efficiency; preserve accuracy across the profiled sequence.
next_gate.third: Close INT8/PWP numerical identities and an executable SHARED96 boundary before matched Synopsys throughput/area/energy.
